Option O4 references missing risk Monolith becomes a high-blast-radius component for failures and changes.

Decision reference missing: Parallel lane partitioning is derived from work_plan.json dependency DAG; tasks with no cross-dependencies are assigned to separate lanes with file-path-scoped workspace partitions.
Decision reference missing: Deterministic merge ordering in C18 is independent of wall-clock lane completion timing; ordering is defined by work_plan.json task IDs to ensure reproducibility.

Decision reference missing: Each lane emits its own stage_handoff artifacts at lane-internal boundaries (Generate→Validate→Review→Patch) plus a lane-completion handoff; the global orchestrator emits top-level stage_handoffs at Intake→Parallel, Parallel→Integration, Integration→Judge, and Judge→Freeze boundaries.

Decision reference missing: Integration conflict resolution has deterministic thresholds: conflicts below threshold are auto-resolved by C21 with bounded op caps; conflicts above threshold trigger HITL escalation per K12 mitigation.

Decision reference missing: Multi-vendor routing enforced by C11: writer models (C14) differ from reviewer models (C16, C20) differ from judge model (C23); per-lane reviewers are findings-only with no write permissions.

Decision reference missing: Context packs are compiled per-lane by C11 using lane-scoped workspace partitions; integration-stage context packs include cross-lane artifacts selected by deterministic priority rules bounded by configured token/byte limits.
Decision reference missing: Secrets scanning runs at per-lane validation (C15) and integration validation (C19) checkpoints, plus a final pre-freeze scan in C24.

Decision reference missing: Partial-freeze is not supported in this candidate; if global budgets are exhausted before integration completes, the orchestrator checkpoints and emits a stage_handoff for deterministic resume rather than producing an incomplete freeze bundle.
